question: Who built the Red Fort in Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shah Jahan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Red Fort in Delhi **was built by the **Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan **in the** mid-17th century.**
 
• The construction of the fort began in **1638** and was completed in **1648.**
 
• It was originally known as the **"Qila-i-Mubarak"** or the **blessed fort.**
 
• The fort was built as a** palace for the emperor** and was later used as a** residence for other members** of the royal family.
 
• It was also used as a **military base** and as a location for **important state events.**
 
• The Red Fort is a** UNESCO World Heritage Site** and is considered to be one of the finest examples of** Mughal architecture** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jahangir** was a **Mughal Emperor **who ruled from **1605 to 1627**, before the construction of the Red Fort began.

 
 
• He was known for his **patronage of the arts **and for** his liberal policies** towards **non-Muslims.**
 
 
 
• **Babur **was the **founder of the Mughal Empire** in India.
 
 
• He ruled from **1526 to 1530** and was known for his **military conquests **and for his memoirs, the** Baburnama.**
 
 
 
• **Humayun **was a **Mughal Emperor **who ruled from **1530 to 1540** and again from **1555 to 1556.**
 
 
• He was the** father of Akbar**, one of the most famous Mughal Emperors.
